snippet: Vendor inspection record: a nine-unit C24 run started June 12; four units shipped June 30 and five were listed for July 4 shipment.
Thermal failure: Side Caps 'unfit' due to mold/cure issues.
Pilot Build Issues: Parts not straight, missing countersinks, paint cure time failure.
Vendor admits 'bow' due to paint cure effect; lack of curing fixture identified.
Photo evidence: Gap check reveals significant shrinkage/interference in plastic fit.
The August 15 status report scheduled RTM for August 16 and Pilot for August 22.
The October 3 status report marked FCS At Risk; its cover listed October 29 as the current plan.
Project Status recovered: 'On Schedule'. FCS set for 11/7.
Submitted ECOs for plastic parts (Sidecaps, Bolster, Meter Lens).
Finalized ECO 13707; planning transition for next year.
